frames.title: Lesson 135 · Mixed Conditionals — practice and contrast

body: **Foco:** Mixed Conditionals — prática e contraste.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (análises).
**Texto do dia:** notícia / reportagem curta.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo contrastar condicionais mistas com o tipo 2 e o tipo 3, em uma notícia.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.headline: Report: Flood Barrier Plan Was Dropped; Town Pays the Price
paras: A river town that rejected a flood barrier ten years ago is now facing repair bills of €20 million. “**If the council had approved** the barrier, **we would not be** counting the cost today,” said resident Ana Moura. “**If it were** up to me, **I would have built** it years ago.”

An engineer added: “**If the town were** richer, it **would have afforded** the barrier. **If they had known** the river was rising, they **might have acted**.” The council says it **would invest** now **if it had** the funds.

items.q: The barrier was built ten years ago.
Residents say the town is paying for a past decision.
The council has plenty of funds now.

head: Tipo
Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: If it **were** up to me, I **would build** it.
If + past perfect, would have + pp
If they **had approved** it, we **would have been** safe.
If the council **had approved**, we **would not be** paying now.
If + past simple, would have + pp
If the town **were** richer, it **would have afforded** it.

blocks.body: Para decidir o tipo: **quando** é a condição e **quando** é o resultado? Passado + passado = 3º tipo; presente + presente = 2º; passado + presente (ou o inverso) = misto.

items.s: If the council had approved it, we ___ not be counting the cost today. (would)
If the town ___ richer, it would have afforded it. (be, were)
If they had known, they ___ have acted. (might)
If it were up to me, I ___ have built it years ago. (would)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.expt: The gutter overflow flooded the street.
The river gauge showed a sharp rise.

body: **Count the cost** — Arcar com o custo
**Pay the price** — Pagar o preço
**A day late and a dollar short** — Tarde demais e insuficiente
**Close the stable door after the horse has bolted** — Trancar a porta depois do roubo
**Too little, too late** — Pouco e tarde demais
**Learn the hard way** — Aprender na marra
**Rue the day** — Lamentar o dia
**Save for a rainy day** — Guardar para dias difíceis
**And today?** — E hoje?
**If you had built the barrier, we would not be paying now.** — Se tivessem construído a barreira, não estaríamos pagando agora.
**If we had had the funds, we would have built it.** — Se tivéssemos tido os fundos, teríamos construído.

blocks.title: Town hall
lines: If you had built the barrier, we would not be paying now.
Se tivessem construído a barreira, não estaríamos pagando agora.
If we had had the funds, we would have built it.
Se tivéssemos tido os fundos, teríamos construído.
If we had more money, we would invest immediately.
Se tivéssemos mais dinheiro, investiríamos imediatamente.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: Organização da informação pela entonação: a informação nova ou final recebe a nota que cai; listas e ideias incompletas sobem.
words: We need time ↗, money ↗, and trust ↘.
If it fails ↗, we try again ↘.
Having left early ↗, she missed it ↘.

prompts.q: Make a 3rd conditional about a past mistake.
prompts.model: If they had listened, they would have avoided the flood.

prompts.q: Make a mixed conditional about a present effect.
prompts.model: If they had built it, the town would be safe today.

prompts.q: Make a 2nd conditional about the present.
prompts.model: If we had the funds, we would invest now.

blocks.task: Write 6 sentences about a past decision with the 2nd, 3rd and mixed conditionals (two of each).
blocks.model: If I had a car, I would drive to work. If we were richer, we would have bought the flat. If I had taken the course, I would earn more now. If they had left early, they would have caught the train. If it were my decision, I would have started sooner. If she had accepted, she would be a manager today.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
